evidence.excerpt: I've heard some folks talking about Oaks analysis around the neighborhood, seems like people are trying to make sense of what's going on with the team, I'm just trying to keep up with the news like everyone else
I've heard people talking about Oaks analysis around my neighborhood, it seems like everyone's got an opinion on it, I'm just trying to stay focused on my work and taking care of my family
I feel like The Oaks are gearing up for a great season, I've heard they're a full go for opening night and their starting five has been announced, it's got me excited to see how they'll do.
I've heard The Oaks are looking strong for the upcoming season, and I'm excited to see how they do.
I've seen the Oaks struggle in their preseason performance, it's got me a bit worried about how they'll do this season.
Look, I don’t know what kind of "fame-rise" you’re talking about—I’m just a person who plays guitar at The Oaks sometimes and fixes my own appliances because rent isn’t cheap.

I feel like the Oaks team is trying to reach out to us, to the community, and it's good to see that.
I feel like community engagement with the Oaks team is something I've heard about, but I don't really know much about it.
I feel like the community is pretty supportive of the Oaks team, I see people around here talking about them and it seems like they're trying to engage with us more.
